description: Make the backend of a builder app, or change it, from plain words ("members book classes, staff confirm them", "ask for a phone number on bookings"). The AI writes the backend (tables, rules, sign in, files, automations) and it is checked against the safety rules; a live backend only changes after apply_builder_backend. Costs builder credits (backendSpec for a new backend, backendEdit for a change, see builder_status prices; given back when it fails). Tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. Follow it with builder_backend_status. Developer role. Pro and Team (credits needed). On Free (design only) the call answers 403 code BUILDER_DESIGN_ONLY: tell the person building the app's code is on Pro and Team.
